canonical_claim_candidate: For every first-order language L, theory T, and sentence phi, semantic consequence T entails phi implies derivability of phi from T in a fixed sound proof calculus.
domain_and_universes: Expected domain: an arbitrary first-order language, a set of sentences as theory, and a sentence. Exact universe levels and the type representing derivations depend on the selected calculus.
hypotheses: semantic consequence: every nonempty L-structure satisfying T satisfies phi
conclusion: Expected conclusion: phi is derivable from T in a source-selected formal proof calculus; exact derivability predicate remains open.
